summary: Procure 30 ConvoLens enterprise seats + SCIM/Okta SSO and security attestation
business_justification: Product & Support teams require platform-level conversation analytics for transcript search, call tagging, and sentiment pipelines. Consolidating on ConvoLens reduces engineering-maintained pipelines and provides faster insights for CSAT initiatives. Current process using ad-hoc tooling is causing duplicated effort and delays in escalations.
required_deliverables: SAML SSO integration via Okta (IdP-initiated + SP-initiated)
Signed DPA and data processing addendum
SOC2 Type II or equivalent security report
acceptance_criteria: 30 seats provisioned and visible in org admin console
SCIM sync tested against staging with expected group mappings
SAML SSO working for >3 pilot users across Okta org
Security docs uploaded to internal vendor registry and approved by Security team
Billing account set up with cost center and tags
steps_to_provision: Procurement: confirm PO terms and route to Finance for P-Card/PO
Security: complete vendor questionnaire and review SOC2
IT/Access: configure Okta app and exchange metadata with ConvoLens
Engineering: run SCIM trial sync against staging and validate user/group provisioning
Support: invite pilot users and verify seat assignments
dependencies: INT-67210 (multi-team-seat-reallocation) - may affect seat count availability
Security vendor onboarding SLA: 7 business days for initial review
estimated_timeline: Target provisioning within 3 weeks after signed agreement; security review may add up to 7 business days.
notes: Security asked for an in-line data flow diagram and confirmation of encryption-at-rest keys. Finance prefers vendor invoices billed annually with cost-center tags. Contract redlines expected on indemnity clause.
